stock.description: Comtec Solar Systems Group Limited, an investment holding entity primarily active in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong, centers its operations on the research, manufacturing, and distribution of mono-crystalline solar wafers and ingots. The company organizes its diverse activities into two principal divisions: Mono-crystalline and Solar Products, and Solar and Power Storage. Beyond its core offerings, Comtec delivers a suite of advisory services covering the investment, engineering, procurement, development, and operational aspects of solar photovoltaic power stations. Its portfolio also includes polysilicon products and full solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services. Expanding into the energy storage domain, the company is deeply involved in the research, development, design, integration, and sale of advanced lithium battery management and battery systems tailored for electric vehicles and general power storage applications, alongside the production and sale of various power storage solutions. Furthermore, Comtec facilitates trade in solar-related components, equipment, and goods, and engages in the generation of solar power. Established in 1999, the company maintains its headquarters in Changzhou, People's Republic of China.
